notes.title: [2025-09-23] Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Players!

We bring you the Patch Notes for September 23, 2025.

Thanks to your feedback and support, we’re steadily improving.



Please leave your honest feedback in the form below!



https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdVf6B85PI2yCVD9moitOykHJTq2VuQZ9Mn40catomUgHZ8Nw/viewform?usp=header



Here are the patch details.





Removed various inconveniences in Gifts.

Reduced business time.

Greatly increased the wagon’s attack power!
Now you can throw it to hunt or stun monsters more effectively.

Improved some inconveniences in UI usage.

Added automatic item pickup.

Slightly lowered Guardian difficulty.

Made guardian attack ranges more visible

Improved wagon movement.
Explore diverse fields with smoother driving!

Improved UX of Weapon Enchant

Fixed several other bugs.

notes.title: [2025-02-26] Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are pleased to announce the Food Wagon patch notes for February 27, 2025.
We have prioritized and worked on features based on your valuable feedback for convenience.
We will continue to evolve Food Wagon through your feedback.
Please support the growth of the game with honest feedback through the in-game feedback form.

Thank you!
Luminous Tales

Update Summary

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/3ad965c1ab71690a5cf8d86c21234078d3155b23.jpg

New and Improved Content:

 Map UI added!
 Vine now dies after a certain time
 Some monster effects improved
 Boss spawn locations fixed


Fixes:

 Fixed issue where all stacked items were consumed when cooking skewer
 Changed calculation method for cooking
 Improved save data stability

notes.title: [2025-02-26] Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Luminous Tales.
Thank you to everyone who played the demo during Steam Next Fest.
We are working hard to improve the game by taking your valuable feedback into account.

Below are the changes made based on the feedback and additional features that are scheduled to be fixed.

Thank you.

Bug Fixes

 Improved interaction with box props
 Fixed issue where skill smash attack power was not applied
 Fixed issue where skill power smash attack power was not applied
 Fixed issue where the attack power of the Nature God's Deer was reset to 0 during Phase Shift
 Fixed issue where the death animation of the Nature God's Deer was skipped
 Fixed issue where the Nature God's Deer could be blocked by vines during a charge
 Fixed issue where movement continued when placing a tent/campfire while moving during settlement
 Improved game pad input for changing skill equipment
 Fixed "Exit Menu" text
 Fixed issue where clicking "No" on the "Type" pop-up in the menu would cause the game to become unresponsive
 Fixed description text for the Wagon Adventurer
 Fixed issue where some boxes could not be accessed
 Fixed some steep slopes on some maps
 Adjusted the timing of vine sound output


Numerical Adjustments

 Lowered the maximum stack of Nature God's Blessing to 5
 Modified so that the Nature God's Blessing stack can be increased with skills
 Increased the movement speed of the player and wagon
 Improved player evasion function
 Lowered the health of the Nature God's vines
 Reduced the attack power multiplier of the Nature God's Deer's charge
 Developed HP/MP/SP recovery function when moving through the player's gate portal
 Developed player save function and HP/MP/SP recovery function during sleep
 Increased monster density


Content Addition

 Implemented the Nature God's Deer magic circle pattern
 Implemented input device switching function
 Added general attack effect for player's close-range weapon
 Developed effect output function when the player attacks
 Developing evasion effect "Dash Dust"
 Developing evasion effect


Other

 Fixed the operation of the Wagon Jam function during settlement


Planned Updates

 Simple mini-map function
 Visual key guidance function
 Placement of signposts to guide the way
 Time stop function when leveling up
